outputs.explanation: Panel A shows representative flow cytometric dot plots for gating of B cells and B-cell subsets; it is not a quantitative comparison plot and contains no significance indicators.
Panel B shows a representative flow cytometric plot for identification of plasma cells (PC); it is a representative gating plot, not a quantitative statistical comparison.
Panel C shows the MBC gating strategy as representative flow cytometry plots with percentages, not a quantitative plot comparing groups with statistics.
Panel D is a color-coded overlay of representative flow cytometry populations (MBC, GC, naive) showing marker expression, not a quantitative statistical plot with significance annotations.
Panel E shows representative MBC subset gating plots with percentages; it is not a quantitative comparison plot and contains no statistical significance indicators.
